author: Kənd Həyatı
description:
A whole watermelon transformed into a hearty village feast 🥩🍉 In this video, we fill a fresh watermelon with seasoned beef and fragrant rice, then slowly cook it using a rustic countryside method.

As everything cooks together, the beef becomes tender and juicy while the rice absorbs the rich flavors of the meat, spices, and natural juices inside the watermelon. The result is an unusual but delicious combination with an impressive presentation.

This rustic stuffed watermelon brings together simple ingredients and creative village cooking. Tender beef, flavorful rice, and slow cooking turn an ordinary watermelon into a memorable meal made for sharing. 🌿🔥🍚
title: Rice & Beef Stuffed Watermelon | Rustic Village Recipe 🥩🍉
